bio.text: John Laird was re-elected to the California State Senate on November 5, 2024, representing a district that includes Santa Cruz, San Benito and Monterey Counties and most of San Luis Obispo County.
He was Secretary of the California Natural Resources Agency under Gov. Jerry Brown from January 2011 to January 2019, and earlier served three terms in the State Assembly, first elected in 2002.
Laird served on the Santa Cruz City Council from 1981 to 1990, including two terms as mayor, and on the Cabrillo College Board of Trustees from 1994 to 2002.
Raised in Vallejo, he graduated from the University of California, Santa Cruz, in 1972 and is a long-time Santa Cruz resident.
